confidence_notes: The food and drink anchors come from the web searches I ran. I compared typical-price aggregators: Traveltables' Kenting page (last updated July 2023), Nomad Watch's Kenting page, and Numbeo's Taitung page in NT$. I also used travel-guide price ranges for Kenting bars. I adjusted the prices up a little because Kenting is a resort town and July is peak season, then converted them at roughly 31-32 TWD per USD. The coffee and inexpensive-meal figures are the most reliable because the sources broadly agree: about NT$110-130 for a cappuccino and NT$120-180 for a cheap meal. Beer is moderately reliable: aggregators give NT$65-95, while tourist bars charge NT$100-200, so the anchor sits in between. The mid-range meal for two is less certain because sources range from about USD 27 (older Traveltables data) to NT$1,500 (Numbeo Taitung). Cocktail prices come from Kenting bar guides reporting NT$150-350 at bars and beach bars, and NT$350-450 at upscale hotel bars. I found no direct per-glass wine price, so the wine figure is estimated from its local relationship to beer and cocktail prices. I did not search for accommodation prices. Those anchors are my own overall estimates for Kenting's peak summer season, when prices are much higher than in the off-season, and they are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kenting is a small, seasonal beach resort in Pingtung County, so there is little city-level data. I based the estimates on Kenting-specific aggregator figures, cross-checked against Taitung, Kaohsiung and Taiwan-wide averages. I then adjusted up for resort-area and tourist-strip prices on Kenting Street. Accommodation is based on Taiwan resort-town patterns, where minsu guesthouses and hostels charge peak rates in summer.
